title: dianthus orientalis subsp. ketzkhovelii
intro: Dianthus orientalis subsp. ketzkhovelii, commonly known as a type of pink carnation, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the carnation family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, offering several health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including wound healing and pain relief. The bioactive constituents of Dianthus orientalis subsp. ketzkhovelii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. These compounds may help to modulate immune responses, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antioxidant activities, making this plant a potential source of natural remedies.
